name: Sacrifice value
explanation: Sacrificing creatures can repeatedly convert bodies into death triggers; fodder and costs still matter.

name: Graveyard recycling
explanation: Filling the graveyard supplies cards for recursion; this does not prove an infinite loop.

name: Reanimation targets
explanation: Reanimation can bypass the mana costs of large creatures.

name: Commander combat pressure
explanation: Scaling and evasion can threaten commander damage when applied to the commander.

name: Token overrun
explanation: Wide boards turn collective buffs into large combat swings.

name: Counter multiplication
explanation: Proliferate builds on existing counters; counter types and targets must align.

name: Graveyard payoff
explanation: Graveyard filling supports effects that reference graveyard contents.

name: Artifact value
explanation: Artifact density supplies material for artifact payoffs; exact triggers govern output.

name: Life exchange
explanation: Life gain and drain coexist; inspect triggers before assuming they form a loop.

name: ETB reuse
explanation: Blink can reuse enters abilities; costs, targets and timing still apply.
